invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Map object either from a new HashMap instance or from the context.mapToPair call, with no path returning null.
If partitionPaths is not null and not empty, the map keys are 1:1 with the input partitions; otherwise, the map is empty.
If the size limit is positive, non-trivial results only occur if there are non-empty partitionPaths, otherwise result is empty.
When the small file limit is positive with non-empty partition paths, the result's keys match the input partitions.
The result can only be empty if at least one of these preconditions is met.
